title: AWS targets first Saudi Arabia cloud region launch
summary: AWS says its first cloud infrastructure region in Saudi Arabia, representing a $5.3B+ investment with three Availability Zones, is on track to launch in December 2026; no specific day has been confirmed.

sources.title: AWS to launch first cloud infrastructure region in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia by December 2026

title: Android 17 QPR2 stable release expected
summary: Android 17 QPR2, in beta since July 2026, is expected to go stable around the December 2026 Pixel Feature Drop, continuing Google's quarterly release cadence; Google has not announced an exact date.

sources.title: Google releases Android 17 QPR2 Beta 2 for Pixel

title: Istio 1.30 reaches end of support
summary: Under Istio's policy of supporting a minor release until six weeks after the N+2 release ships, Istio 1.30 is expected to lose support around December 2026, following the 1.32 release; istio.io has not yet posted the exact day.

sources.title: Support for Istio 1.29 ends on the 12th of October, 2026

title: OpenAI removes three image-generation API models
summary: OpenAI is retiring gpt-image-1-mini, gpt-image-1.5 and chatgpt-image-latest from its API on this date, directing developers to gpt-image-2 as the replacement; it notified developers of the change on June 2, 2026.

sources.title: OpenAI Deprecates Three Image APIs by December 2026

title: OpenAI retires gpt-image-1-mini, gpt-image-1.5 and chatgpt-image-latest
summary: OpenAI removes the gpt-image-1-mini, gpt-image-1.5 and chatgpt-image-latest models from the API on this date, directing developers to migrate to gpt-image-2; this follows the DALL-E 2/3 retirement in May 2026.

sources.title: OpenAI deprecates three image APIs by December 2026

title: Redis Open Source 8.0 reaches end of life
summary: Redis's official version-management page lists Redis Open Source 8.0 with an end-of-life date of December 1, 2026, after which it no longer receives security updates or critical bug fixes.

title: Amazon EKS Kubernetes 1.34 standard support ends
summary: Standard support for Amazon EKS clusters running Kubernetes 1.34 ends December 2, 2026; extended support (at additional cost) then runs through December 2, 2027.

sources.title: Understand the Kubernetes version lifecycle on EKS

title: EU AI Act synthetic-content labeling duty takes effect
summary: The EU AI Act's Digital Omnibus provisional agreement deferred the Article 50(2) duty requiring generative AI systems already on the market before Aug 2, 2026 to apply machine-readable AI-content marking/watermarking to December 2, 2026.

sources.title: EU AI Act Omnibus Agreement — Postponed High-Risk Deadlines and Other Key Changes
Transparency obligations under Article 50 of the AI Act
sources.publisher: European Commission — Shaping Europe's digital future

sources.title: The EU AI Act's Transparency Rules: A Practical Guide to Article 50

title: EU AI Act watermarking grace period ends for already-deployed systems
summary: Article 50 AI-content transparency obligations took effect Aug 2, 2026 on schedule even as the Digital Omnibus delayed the broader Annex III high-risk deadline to Dec 2027; a narrower four-month grace period for watermarking/labeling of systems already deployed before Aug 2026 runs out Dec 2, 2026.

sources.title: EU AI Act High-Risk Deadline Pushed to December 2027

title: Docker Engine 25.0 branch reaches end of life
summary: The Docker Engine 25.0 release branch reaches its projected end-of-life date, after which it no longer receives patches.

title: NeurIPS 2026
summary: The Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems runs December 6-12, 2026 in Sydney, Australia, with satellite meetings in Atlanta and Paris.

sources.title: NeurIPS 2026 splits across Sydney, Atlanta and Paris in December

title: AWS Infrastructure Composer standalone console reaches end of support
summary: AWS ends support for the Infrastructure Composer standalone console on December 7, 2026, directing users to the visual canvas inside CloudFormation console mode instead.

title: Black Hat Europe 2026
summary: Black Hat Europe 2026 runs December 7-10 at ExCeL London, with two days of training followed by the main briefings and Arsenal conference on December 9-10.

title: Federal agencies must fully adopt CISA's risk-based BOD 26-04 remediation timelines
summary: Under Binding Operational Directive 26-04 (issued June 10, 2026), federal civilian agencies must fully adopt new risk-based vulnerability remediation timelines by December 7, 2026, including a 3-day window for the most severe KEV-listed, internet-exposed flaws.

sources.title: CISA Directive Highlights Risk-Based Vulnerability Management
FedRAMP Notice on BOD 26-04 adoption deadline

title: CISA's risk-based patch directive reaches full compliance deadline
summary: CISA's Binding Operational Directive 26-04, effective June 10, 2026, replaces flat KEV remediation timelines with a risk-based model (as fast as 3 days for the highest-risk flaws) and gives federal civilian agencies 180 days to be fully compliant, a deadline landing on December 7, 2026.

sources.title: CISA's BOD 26-04 Signals the End of 'Patch Everything'
CISA tells govt agencies to patch critical exploited flaws in 3 days

title: Docker retires the Content Trust / Notary v1 service
summary: Docker Content Trust and the Notary v1 service (notary.docker.io) shut down completely on December 8, 2026, following earlier brownout windows; Docker directs users to Sigstore/Cosign or Notation instead.

title: Microsoft Patch Tuesday - December 2026
summary: Microsoft's monthly scheduled security update release, falling on the second Tuesday of the month per its published cadence.

sources.title: Next Patch Tuesday: Microsoft Update Calendar 2026

title: GitHub Enterprise Server 3.19 reaches end of support
summary: GitHub's official release table lists December 9, 2026 as the closing/end-of-support date for GitHub Enterprise Server 3.19, which was released December 9, 2025.

title: Azure AI Foundry retires GPT-4o
summary: Microsoft's Foundry model-retirement schedule sets gpt-4o (2024-05-13) to retire from Azure AI Foundry on December 9, 2026, auto-upgrading Standard SKU deployments to gpt-5.6-sol; the 2024-08-06 and 2024-11-20 GPT-4o snapshots follow on April 14, 2027.

sources.title: Foundry Models lifecycle and support policy

title: Broadcom Q4 FY2026 earnings (expected)
summary: Broadcom is expected to report fourth-quarter fiscal 2026 results around December 10, following its usual second-week-of-December pattern (Q4 FY2025 results were reported December 11, 2025); the company had not yet confirmed the exact date as of this sweep.

sources.title: Broadcom (AVGO) Earnings Dates, Call Summary & Reports

title: AKS retires Azure Linux with OS Guard (preview)
summary: Azure Kubernetes Service stops supporting Azure Linux with OS Guard (preview) on December 10, 2026 (no new node pools, images, or patches), with full removal following on March 10, 2027; Azure Container Linux is the replacement.

sources.title: [Retirement] Azure Linux with OS Guard (Public Preview) retires on December 10, 2026. Removal on March 10, 2027

title: Azure Database for PostgreSQL 14 standard support ends
summary: Microsoft's version support policy lists Azure Database for PostgreSQL 14 as reaching end of Standard Support on December 11, 2026, after which only paid Extended Support applies.

sources.title: Azure Database for PostgreSQL version support policy

title: OpenAI removes legacy GPT-5 and o3 model snapshots from API
summary: OpenAI will remove several dated GPT-5 and o3 snapshots (gpt-5-2025-08-07, gpt-5-mini-2025-08-07, gpt-5-nano-2025-08-07, gpt-5-pro-2025-10-06, o3-2025-04-16, o3-pro-2025-06-10) from the API on December 11, 2026.

title: OpenAI retires older GPT-5 and o3 API snapshots
summary: OpenAI notified developers that older GPT-5 and o3 model snapshots will be removed from the API on December 11, 2026.

title: Cybersecurity Information Sharing Act of 2015 reauthorization deadline
summary: A stopgap federal funding bill passed in early September 2026 extends the Cybersecurity Information Sharing Act of 2015, which gives liability protection to private companies voluntarily sharing cyber threat data with the government, from its September 30 expiration to December 11, 2026.

sources.title: Stopgap funding bill temporarily extends key cyber info-sharing law
CR extends cyber info sharing law through December

title: CA/Browser Forum Multi-Perspective Issuance Corroboration reaches five-perspective requirement
summary: Under CA/Browser Forum Ballot SMC010, certificate authorities must corroborate domain-control validation and CAA checks from five geographically diverse network perspectives across at least two RIR regions by December 15, 2026, the final step of the phased MPIC rollout against BGP-hijack attacks on certificate issuance.

sources.title: Ballot SMC010: Introduction of Multi-Perspective Issuance Corroboration

title: Azure AI Foundry retires Whisper, TTS and TTS-HD (version 001)
summary: Azure AI Foundry / Azure OpenAI retires the version-001 Whisper, TTS and TTS-HD model deployments on December 15, 2026.

title: Kubernetes 1.38 scheduled release
summary: Kubernetes v1.38.0, the project's final minor release of 2026, is scheduled to ship December 16, 2026, continuing the roughly 15-week release cadence.

title: Micron fiscal Q1 2027 earnings (expected)
summary: Financial-calendar trackers project Micron reports fiscal Q1 2027 results around December 16, 2026 (unconfirmed by Micron); recent quarters have featured record AI/HBM-driven memory demand.

title: Ruby's next annual release expected (version not yet announced)
summary: Ruby has shipped a new major/minor version every December 25 since 2013, most recently Ruby 4.0 on Dec 25, 2025; the next release would follow that pattern in 2026, though it has not yet been officially named or announced.

title: Kubernetes 1.35 enters maintenance mode, then reaches end of life
summary: Kubernetes 1.35 ("Timbernetes") enters maintenance mode on December 28, 2026 and reaches end of life on February 28, 2027, per the official Kubernetes release schedule.

title: Azure FXT Edge Filer reaches retirement
summary: Microsoft's own Lifecycle page confirms Azure FXT Edge Filer retires December 31, 2026, resolving inconsistent secondary reporting that cited a September 30, 2026 batch date; software-based vFXT for Azure is unaffected.

sources.title: Azure FXT Edge Filer - Microsoft Lifecycle

title: PHP 8.2 reaches end of life
summary: PHP 8.2 exits its security-only support window; after this date it receives no further patches, including for new vulnerabilities.

sources.title: PHP End-of-Life Dates: Support Timeline for Every Version (2026)
